strict_redactions.dumps: Forbidden. No cookie, session storage, localStorage, or browser profile dumps.
strict_redactions.fake_citations: Forbidden. All citations must correspond to verified sources.
strict_redactions.fake_market_numbers: Forbidden. Statistics and metrics must be manually verified and truthful.
strict_redactions.fake_urls: Forbidden. URLs must be valid and manually checked.
strict_redactions.financial_advice: Forbidden. No trading signals, buy/sell targets, position sizing, or predictions.
strict_redactions.local_paths: Forbidden. No environmental paths, pytest paths, Temp, or AppData references.
strict_redactions.secrets_tokens: Forbidden. No API keys, passwords, bearer tokens, or authorization headers.
strict_redactions.webhooks: Forbidden. Webhook URLs must not be printed or stored.
